title: ResponseUser
description:
The user in the organization.

Introduced in VPP License Management 2.0.

clientUserId.description: The unique identifier for a user in your organization.

idHash.description: The hash of the user’s unique store identifier. The `idHash` field is only present when the user has an associated Apple Account.

inviteCode.description: The invitation code that associates an Apple Account to a user.

status.description: The current status of the user in the organization.
